NNG.name: 일반 명사
NNG.meaning: regular words for everyday things like objects, places, concepts

NNP.name: 고유 명사
NNP.meaning: names of specific people, places, organizations, brands

NNB.name: 의존 명사
NNB.meaning: words that can't stand alone and need another word (것, 수, 바)

NP.name: 대명사
NP.meaning: words used instead of nouns: I, you, he, she, it, this, that

NR.name: 수사
NR.meaning: numbers and counting words: one, two, first, twenty

VV.name: 동사
VV.meaning: action words: go, eat, see, do, make

VV-I.name: 동사 변형 (irregular)
VV-I.meaning: irregular verb form with special consonant changes

VV-R.name: 동사 변형 (regular)
VV-R.meaning: regular verb form with standard conjugation

VA.name: 형용사
VA.meaning: descriptive words: good, big, pretty, cold, hot

VA-I.name: 형용사 변형 (irregular)
VA-I.meaning: an irregularly conjugated descriptive word with a special stem change

VA-R.name: 형용사 변형 (regular)
VA-R.meaning: a regularly conjugated descriptive word with a standard stem form

VX.name: 보조 용언
VX.meaning: helper words that add meaning to main verbs/adjectives: want, can, cannot

VCP.name: 긍정 지정사
VCP.meaning: is/are - connects a noun to something else

VCN.name: 부정 지정사
VCN.meaning: is not/are not - negative form of being

MM.name: 관형사
MM.meaning: words that come before nouns to specify them: this, that, new, old

MAG.name: 일반 부사
MAG.meaning: words that describe how something is done: well, very, really, quickly

IC.name: 감탄사
IC.meaning: exclamations and reactions: oh, wow, yes, ah

JKS.name: 주격 조사
JKS.meaning: particle marking the subject of a sentence: 이, 가

JKC.name: 보격 조사
JKC.meaning: particle used with 'become' to show what something turns into

JKO.name: 목적격 조사
JKO.meaning: particle marking the object of an action: 을, 를

JKB.name: 부사격 조사
JKB.meaning: location/direction particles: to, from, at, in, on (에, 에서, 로, 에게)

JKV.name: 호격 조사
JKV.meaning: particle when calling someone's name: 아, 야

JKQ.name: 인용격 조사
JKQ.meaning: quotation particle: said that, called (라고, 하고)

JX.name: 보조사
JX.meaning: emphasis/topic particles: also, only, too (은, 는, 도, 만)

JC.name: 접속 조사
JC.meaning: and with nouns: with, and (와, 과, 하고)

EP.name: 선어말 어미
EP.meaning: endings that come before the final ending: will, did, was (겠, 였, 었)

EF.name: 종결 어미
EF.meaning: sentence-ending particles: 다, 요, 까, 죠

EC.name: 연결 어미
EC.meaning: connecting words between clauses: and, but, because, if (고, 면, 지만, 니까)

ETN.name: 명사형 어미
ETN.meaning: turns verbs into nouns: doing, reading (기, 음)

ETM.name: 관형사형 어미
ETM.meaning: turns words into modifiers: the one who..., the thing that... (ᆫ, 은, 는)

XPN.name: 체언 접두사
XPN.meaning: prefixes added to nouns: new, first, fake (새, 첫, 가짜)

XSN.name: 명사 파생 접미사
XSN.meaning: suffixes that turn other words into nouns: -ness, -ship (적, 성, 님)

XSV.name: 동사 파생 접미사
XSV.meaning: suffixes that turn nouns into verbs: -ize, -ify (하, 되, 시키)

XSA.name: 형용사 파생 접미사
XSA.meaning: suffixes that turn words into adjectives: -like, -able (스럽, 답다)

XSM.name: 부사 파생 접미사
XSM.meaning: suffixes that turn words into adverbs: -ly (이, 히)

XR.name: 어근
XR.meaning: the base part of a word before prefixes/suffixes

Z_CODA.name: 구어체 덧붙은 받침
Z_CODA.meaning: extra sounds added in casual speech (like -m in thing-m)

NF.name: 명사 추정 범주
NF.meaning: unknown words guessed to be nouns

NV.name: 용언 추정 범주
NV.meaning: unknown words guessed to be verbs or adjectives

NA.name: 분석 불가능 단어
NA.meaning: words that can't be analyzed at all
